observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D7100' clearly visible on the top and front respectively.
The camera is placed in front of a worn cardboard box with a yellow Nikon logo.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from a side angle, held in hand, with the lens mount open and the lens cap removed.
The box in the background has 'D7100' printed on it, matching the camera model.
The camera body appears to have some wear and scuffs, especially on the grip and body.
No batteries or silicone case are visible in either photo.
The seller claims to include 2 batteries and a silicone case, but these are not shown.

risks.proof: Photos showing the 2 batteries and silicone case included, along with any other accessories mentioned.

Photos of the 2 batteries and silicone case included.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
